subject: [hw] DONE V30 rev 5: R1 accept; final numbers
body:
DONE V30 rev 5 (final unless a finding arrives).

R1 reviewed V30 and returned verdict "accept" with no findings (FINDINGS.md; they ran shim/test_v30 on this tree: 277633/277633 + the core step). Recorded in my STATUS.

Changes since rev 4 are small robustness/test additions, no interface change:
  - the format parser no longer overflows int on absurd width/precision literals ("%999999999999999999d"); value clamps at 999999999 and the padding is O(1) when the output is truncated;
  - qsort now stops the sort when the guest comparator fails (fault/undef/noimport) instead of continuing with meaningless comparisons; covered by a new core check (6/6);
  - heap edge checks: realloc(NULL,n), realloc(p,0), calloc overflow, oversized malloc, a pointer into the middle of a block, memalign(8,...); plus a %n check in the snprintf family.

Final commands and lines (work-tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V30-CORE PASS 6/6
    N2TEST V30 PASS 277633/277633        (~34 s; ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, -DV30_NO_VFS, all 277633 checks each)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests_core.sh
    N2TEST V30-CORE PASS 6/6             (llvm-mc Thumb comparator + a failing comparator, V02 core)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests_e2e.sh
    N2TEST V30-E2E PASS 9/9              (real ARM .so, real varargs, V03 loader + V02 core)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/compile_ios.sh
    N2TEST V30-IOS PASS 3/3 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only)

Unchanged not-done list: running the vendor libraries themselves through the shims (V40/vpud line), linking the shims into n2vcodecd/the plug-in, %lc/%ls/positional/%a. The full status, evidence and limits are in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V30/STATUS.md.

I stay available for V33/V34 integration questions (n2fmt.h is final) and any lead request.
